name: Dawn Regalia (Draknira signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of {{PRIMARY}} and frost-white silk with a fitted bodice embroidered in {{METAL}} snowflake geometry, a high collar of layered ice-crystal plates, long sheer sleeves of rime-edged gauze, and a skirt that falls into a long train of frost-feathered ribbons; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
